name: Air Jordan 12 Retro 'Cherry' 2023
story_html: The 2023 edition of the Air Jordan 12 Retro ‘Cherry’ reintroduces the OG colorway of the shoe that Michael Jordan wore during his penultimate championship season. Highlighted with radiating stitched lines, the white leather upper is fortified with lizard-textured overlays in a bold scarlet finish. The Jumpman logo graces the tongue in black embroidery, matching the shoe’s textile collar lining. The sneaker rides on a Phylon midsole with full-length Zoom Air cushioning. Underfoot, the semi-translucent red rubber outsole reveals black herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate.
